source_refs.note: i) Stem or Root: a main subheading of 19.4 Nomenclature of Aliphatic Organic Compounds, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 41-41.

blocks.text: It gives the longest continuous carbon chain including the carbon bearing the functional group. Lowest possible number is given to the carbon bearing the functional group. If the carbon atoms are joined in a ring, the name is started by “cyclo”.
